source_briefs.title: The Carnac Regio — GM Brief
source_briefs.scope: Five nested Magic-aligned levels beneath the drowned end of the Carnac alignments. Discovered by Dagmar, Spring 1224. Playable 1224–1226.

campaign_clock.detail: Jupiter and Saturn close to 2.1 arcminutes in Aquarius — an evening-sky event, the closest observable great conjunction between 1226 and 2020. It does not unlock a chamber; it makes the level-5 crossing survivable for one night. Hang the lock on the PATH, not the aura: Magic auras do not fluctuate cyclically.
campaign_clock.runway: Fall 1224 → March 1226 — roughly six playable seasons.
campaign_clock.player_facing: Dagmar's established method is premonitions plus astrology, so the date is his to discover in character. Aldebaran (a Behenian fixed star) is the anchor the conjunction points at; the Hyades are the classical rainy stars, which matches the covenant's maritime regio grammar.
campaign_clock.optional: Halley's Comet passed in 1222 — usable in retrospect as what woke the lower levels and produced the 1224 mirror-flash.

scenes.title: Éogan and the capricorn
scenes.hook: On the voyage home from Ireland a Magic-realm capricorn (sea-goat) singles Éogan out and paces his ship — offered as his first familiar prospect. The work is courting it and the binding lab-work, not an instant bond.
scenes.detail:
ADVANCED (Spring 1224): Éogan spotted the capricorn at a river-mouth near Drogheda (it favours salt-meets-fresh water), took a water sample and cast a relocation spell. Courtship and binding are still ahead. Developed: the draw is independent of the 'small fae drawn to Éogan/Stijntje' affinity; its signature specialty is CROSSING THRESHOLDS INTO REGIONES (mythic grounding in Enki's Goat-Fish and Macrobius's Gate of the Gods). Corpus build/bind references and a suggested Might ~12–16 Magic build are recorded. What it wants in exchange remains open.

CARNAC LINK: per the site brief's backstory cascade, the fae were driven WEST into Atlantic and Irish waters c. 225 AD. Éogan's fae attendants (t068) and a Magic capricorn offering itself at an Irish river-mouth are both downstream of the same displacement — a player character is standing in the far end of the Carnac backstory without knowing it.

scenes.title: Confluensis turns the screws — the Grand Tribunal complaint
scenes.hook: The home-front spine for the 22nd: after the public 13th-place "Siege of Shame" at the 1223 Tribunal and Bertrand's cold renege of the book-storage deal, Confluensis moves from soured silence to active reprisal — assembling a complaint against Sjórseiðr while the covenant's magi are scattered north (Dagmar/Valdemar) and south (Wilhelm).
scenes.detail: The documented direction (c022): someone from Confluensis is preparing to bring Rán's open faerie association — and the covenant's OTHER exposed edges — before the Grand Tribunal as a bundled quaesitorial complaint. Live edges it could gather: Valdemar parading the sea-fae Rán at the feast (c022), the unspendable five bags of stolen Roman dragon-gold and its provenance (c026), Mímormr loosed toward the North Sea by Dagmar's errand (t072), and — most dangerous — Wilhelm's ungifted folk-magic teaching with its madness/death toll (t019, t020, q028). Oleron, a Liege that favours Sjórseiðr for beating the other lieges, is the natural counter-ally (t074). What FORM the screw-turning takes first — a formal charge, a whispering campaign, vassal-poaching, or economic pressure through the soured Bertrand arrangement — is the live beat. GM prep 2026-08-09 (t078). Planned opening gambit (t078, 2026-08-15): a FORGED Order-of-Odin letter, manufactured to implicate Valdemar and entered as evidence — details TBD.

scenes.title: The Diedne Garden — a druidic circle on the Channel coast, and the road to initiation
scenes.thread: Vis sources / the Diedne Garden / Valdemar's lineage
scenes.hook: Valdemar has taken on the covenant's newly-won Diedne Garden — a Herbam vis source (3 pawns/yr) on the SOUTH COAST OF THE ENGLISH CHANNEL, not on the Isle of Man. It is an old druidic circle. He can spend the season there harvesting, or he can spend it beginning to initiate himself into the Diedne mystery.
scenes.detail:
UPDATE (owner review 2026-09-19): the Spring 1224 harvest happened (Valdemar took the three Herbam herbs; see the 'Valdemar harvests the Diedne Garden' draft). The INITIATION ladder below remains unplayed and available. CORRECTION OF RECORD: the garden is on the Channel's south coast. Earlier notes placing it inside the Ránargarðr holding on Man were wrong and have been struck from s13.

WHY THE SITING IS BETTER: it sits in the Tribunal's heartland, not on a private island. It was won as a Tribunal prize, so its location is a matter of public record — everyone in Normandy knows who holds it. Every season Valdemar spends there is a season a DIEDNE SITE is being visited, repeatedly, by a magus from the covenant Confluensis is building a case against (s11). Part of the ordeal is simply being seen going.

AND IT COSTS HIM SEASONS: Undrahöll on Man (s13), the garden on the Channel, and the raiding that funds both are three different places. He cannot do all of it. Making him choose between his laboratory and his lineage every year is the engine of this thread.

═══ THE INITIATION ═══
The Diedne are a thousand years dead, so there is no mystagogue. THE SITE IS THE MYSTAGOGUE — the script is kept in the circle, recoverable a rung at a time, and the Ordeals are things the place demands rather than things a person imposes. Give Valdemar a DIEDNE LORE cult ability to accumulate; each season in the garden is a script attempt.

THE LADDER (four rungs, capstone deliberately years out):
1. THE NAMING — Outer Mystery. He says his lineage aloud inside the ring, which is the first time he has said it to anything. Grants Diedne Lore 1. Ordeal cost: minor.
2. THE GREEN SEASON — a modest grove-bound working benefit (study or spontaneous bonus within the circle).
3. THE BENDING — a partial capstone, usable years early: reduce an opponent's Penetration by his Diedne Lore score. Lets him feel it working before he has earned the whole thing.
4. THE UNBROKEN RING — Major Hermetic Virtue. HALVE an opponent's Penetration total against him.

BALANCE NOTE: halving Penetration is very strong — against a Penetration 40 attack that is a flat −20 on top of Parma. Purely defensive, so it does not warp offence, but it will make him near-unhittable by anything short of a Tribunal. Two tunings, pick one:
  (a) BIND IT TO THE RING — it functions only inside a circle he has consecrated, including small ones he can lay in a season or scribe aboard a ship. Thematically exact, self-limiting, and it makes his HOLDINGS the source of his power rather than his person.
  (b) UNCONDITIONAL, PRICE IN THE FLAWS — TMRE convention is one Flaw per script. For a secret Diedne the right Flaws are not personal hardships but LEGIBILITY: his magic begins resisting in a way no catalogued Hermetic Virtue explains. RECOMMENDED — because Confluensis is assembling a bundled complaint (s11), an anomalous resistance is not a rumour but a demonstrable effect a quaesitor can test for, and Valerian is a former Rhine quaesitor sitting at his own dinner table. The capstone virtue becomes the confession.

STILL TO PREP: the Herbam harvest mechanics (season/window, roll, botch risk); whether a guardian, ward, or standing condition sits on the harvest; and what the long-dead Diedne planter left behind. Valdemar also means to pick up basic Herbam in order to work it.

STANDING NOTE: Valdemar is secretly House Diedne (t078). Stacked with the Christian lie (s14) and the fief, this is the highest-stakes exposure any PC carries.

scenes.title: Level 5 — the road, and the March 1226 lock
scenes.hook: Not a room. The far side. The conjunction of 4–5 March 1226 does not unlock a chamber — it makes the crossing survivable, for one night.
scenes.detail:
UPDATE (owner review 2026-09-19): the party reached Level 4 (Fall 1224) and confirmed the deeper way is sealed until the 4-5 March 1226 conjunction; Llewellyn elected to remain in the regio to be present when it opens, and Dagmar undertook to return by then. This scene is the March 1226 return. RoP:M notes that gateways into the Magic Realm proper are guarded by fierce creatures on the FAR side and typically open inward only; insulae are theorised as Magic regiones above aura 10, and aura 10 already reads in core as a gateway to the realm of its affiliation.

THE INVERSION, stated plainly: the goal is not to reach level 5. It is to be standing in the throne room in March 1226 and prevent the stairs from appearing — while the only people who know the building are convinced the party has come to rob their church.

HANG THE LOCK ON THE PATH, NOT THE AURA. Magic auras do not fluctuate cyclically; the aura stays 10 and only the stairs are conditional. DE's Ease-Factor language covers this explicitly.

LLEWELLYN'S PRIZE (§10). RoP:M gives three unprovable models of the Magic Realm — cosms, the Magic Archipelago (insulae and Ferrymen), and tempora (deeper = older; popular with Criamon, which is Dagmar's house). Orkney was already a COSM reading: room-sized spherical microcosms hanging in liquid sky. Carnac in the archipelago idiom is the same phenomenon under a different theory. Two magi, two models, one regio, incompatible maps — exactly the trap Erobos warned about, and exactly the ammunition Llewellyn needs. The published text says sustained exploration by a group of magi MIGHT make one theory harder to sustain, and that the storyguide then decides the underlying truth. That is a campaign-length prize and it is on the table.

OPTIONAL: A. Vibert Douglas identified five conjunctions across 1226–27. If you want the number five doing extra work — five conjunctions, five levels, each keyed to one, the fifth simply the last to arrive.

scenes.title: London — brokering the dragon's gold
scenes.hook: Tormente handed Dagmar a brokerage errand — sell the Roman 'debris' gold on the dragon's behalf. London, the nearest gold market, is where it has to be converted, and the covenant already has form there.
scenes.detail: UPDATE (owner review 2026-09-19): DEFERRED. Exiting Carnac (Fall 1224), Tormente put the brokerage on hold — 'ask me in a few years' — so the covenant is converting the five bags on its own account for now. Park until the dragon revisits it. STUB for next session. The recovered Roman dragon-gold is now Tormente's, and Dagmar owes it a sale. The problem is the one c026 already mapped: a silver-standard economy with no gold coinage, treasure-trove law, and provenance questions — melt to bullion, use a discreet fence / Jewish moneylender / Lombard banker, or commission worked goods. Foxglove knows the London fence from the earlier run (verified events). Live beats: how much of the coin to convert and how (melt vs sell-as-is), what Dagmar reports back to Tormente, and whether the covenant's own Flanders/Bruges bullion channels are now open since the theft is resolved.

scenes.title: Durenmar — Roots for the taking
scenes.hook: At Durenmar, Wilhelm can acquire one or more Roots — the standard foundational Art summae (L6 / Q24, Redcap-deliverable for a small consideration). Pick which he leaves with.
scenes.detail: Roots available to select (all L6 / Q24): Creo — The Wellspring of Making; Intellego — On the Discernment of Truths; Muto — Proteus Bound; Perdo — The Ashes of All Things; Rego — The Ordered Hand; Animal — Of Beasts and Their Natures; Aquam — The Courses of Water; Auram — The Root of Wind and Tempest; Corpus — The Fabric of the Body; Herbam — The Green Mantle; Ignem — First Sparks; Imaginem — The Play of Images; Mentem — The Antechamber of the Mind; Terram — The Bones of the Earth; Vim — The Raw Stuff of Magic. NOTE: a Root (cap 6) only advances an Art Wilhelm can still study up to ~5, so his Rego 17 / Vim 16 gain nothing; his low Arts (Creo, Intellego, Muto, Perdo, Animal, Aquam, Auram, Corpus, Herbam, Ignem, Imaginem, Mentem, Terram — all ≤3) are the useful picks. A specific Root enters the library only when actually acquired (q034).
